article.story: NEW HAVEN, Conn. -- — Riley Fox scored 21 points as Yale beat Cornell 102-68 on Saturday. Fox shot 9 of 11, including 2 of 4 from beyond the arc for the Bulldogs (13-3, 2-1 Ivy League). Nick Townsend scored 20 points and added eight rebounds. Isaac Celiscar shot 4 of 4 from the field and 6 of 6 from the line to finish with 14 points. The Big Red (7-9, 0-3) were led in scoring by Cooper Noard, who finished with 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
